verdict.rationale: Devin documents a persistent environment configuration so every session boots into a known-good state (devin-docs-25), and it runs work in its own workspace and machines, including VPN access to package registries and internal Git hosts (devin-docs-23, devin-docs-27). The evidence does not show the agent autonomously cloning the repo, installing dependencies and configuring itself; the setup reads as configured once rather than self-configured per task. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic repo cloning, autonomous dependency installation, self-directed environment setup, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have an agent automatically clone the repo, install dependencies, and configure its own working environment

citations.quote: Configure it once, and every session boots into that known-good state.
Devin can connect to a VPN from inside its workspace, so sessions can reach internal services such as package registries, databases, and internal Git hosts.
Devin can build and run Android applications directly on its own machine
